summary: Advance the open performance gate by building the missing target-device measurement hand without claiming that local preview evidence is representative hardware proof.

performance.hardware.session-recorder was missing as an executable proof hand; actual target hardware, thermal/compositor access, high-cadence target-display observation, four phones, and human approval remain external substrate/evidence gaps.

Added evidence/target-session-recorder-contract.md for axm.target-session-performance/v1 with opt-in consent, read-only telemetry, bounded resource budgets, compact JSON output, recovery behavior, compatibility, verification, and promotion boundaries.

Recorder uses fixed histograms, at most 64 workload segments, at most 128 recent transition events, one-second client samples, five-second server samples, and a hard 30-minute ceiling; it retains no raw frame log.

Recorder performs read-only local telemetry GETs, exposes authorityWrites=0, receives no simulation state, and excludes user agent, network addresses, raw frames, microphone/camera data, and external upload.

tests/target-session-recorder.test.js passed a synthetic 30-minute run with 108000 frame samples, two workloads, server/RTT/memory/battery/long-task/interruption signals, compact JSON, bounded events, complete/partial semantics, privacy exclusions, and untouched authority.
Promoted package/runtime metadata to 0.12.0 and PLAYABLE ALPHA V12 · TARGET SESSION RECORDER READY; added recorder core/UI/test/contract to required paths and the complete suite.

The opt-in TARGET LAB fit the 1280x720 lobby with readable evidence boundary, metrics, duration, actions, and privacy copy; ordinary launch remains unchanged and closing the panel restored the complete game surface.

A first short smoke used generic COMPLETE wording and visually retained the 30-minute selector, which could overstate evidence; live observation rejected that language despite correct internal duration completion.

Added durationClass and thirtyMinuteGateEligible; only a completed requested 30-minute run can be eligible, and query smokes now display their exact duration plus SMOKE COMPLETE // DOES NOT CLOSE 30-MINUTE GATE.

Recorder panel could close, remain active through a real Clear Signal rematch, and reopen during combat while standings, four racers, track, guards, item slot, events, adaptive music, and connection state remained visually intact.

Final 15-second active-race receipt: 15008.7 ms, four workload segments, 221 interpolation frames, zero snaps, 49 ms preview frame p95, 1.8 ms render p95, 0.05 ms server-tick p95, one Long Task, zero authority writes, false raw/private retention, false 30-minute eligibility, and empty browser logs.
The live smoke proves the measurement hand and preserved composition, not representative-device frame pacing; the in-app preview exposes repeated stills rather than a rolling high-cadence buffer.

npm.cmd test passed 33 focused checks, 45504 interpolation samples, 864 forced snaps, the 108000-frame recorder test, 24 default races, 36 cross-track races, 72 variant races, 32 battles, 30 virtual reliability minutes, 1800 acknowledged actions, 59 resumes, 12 results, restart recovery, HTTP delivery, and 5.3 MB final observed heap delta.

Comparator remains UNKNOWN with zero missing capabilities; performance.hardware.session-recorder is available, client frame budget/server tick remain degraded, and performance.hardware.long-soak remains unknown.
MIRRORSHIFT focused admission has zero errors and one expected physical-phone warning; package-verifier selftest passed 15 assertions; comparator selftest passed; all nine package JSON files parsed.

Broad hub verifier completed with 12 failures outside lane 015: nine in concurrently owned 016 and three missing required evidence paths in concurrently owned 017; games 014, 015, and 018 passed; no foreign files were edited.
Complete 1791-file snapshot found active lanes 014 through 018 and seven active shared seams; lane 015 seams were its own manifest, package, and recorder contract, with no foreign overlap.

Next proof is a complete 30-minute ?perf=1 run on representative hardware joined with an external profiler, thermal/compositor data, and target-display observation; four-phone LAN and human listening/attachment/steward gates remain open.
